about: Milestone NI of ADR 0012, the integration slice of N1b, N2 and N3: the catalogue cases of CF-21 to CF-28 and FX-24/d and /e, recorded on the CE oracle by the fixtures below, which NI wrote and whose runs its exit gate runs on windmill-lite, with control-flow/waits, N2's waits and retries inside containers. Each case is recorded by a run or deferred with a milestone and a reason. CF-23/a and /b put a failure module beside a container, which windmill-lite runs from milestone N3c; ADR 0012's NI bullet says who requires them. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: the catalogue gives it as CF-V3/a, a child flow failing at its pickup, which N3c's row covers with the CF-V cases
a raw flow payload: windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6); the harness runs deployed flows by path only
the Enterprise Edition's squash (EE): the reference establishes no expectation (Q-CF-11), and the oracle is the Community Edition
a raw submission, which does not collapse (CF-V5): windmill-lite never runs raw submissions (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6)

parts.part: the same flow as a preview, which does not collapse and so is not timed
parts.reason: a preview is a raw submission, outside the reference configuration (ADR 0001 sections 1 and 6); the deployed half is recorded
